SUMMARY: Daily Drilling Report #118 demonstrating preventive background LCM
treatment in Moran-North-105 that restricted Barail mud losses to 9.6 bbl/hr with
zero stuck-pipe NPT. VERBATIM OPERATIONAL LOG: 14: :00 HRS: Based on offset
correlation from W-093 and W-087, pre-treated active system with 6 ppb micronized
cellulose fiber at 3,385 m prior to entering middle Barail coal seams. Observed
partial losses of 9.6 bbl/hr at 3,438 m which rapidly self-healed to <1.0 bbl/hr
following a 15 bbl Mica sweep. Confirmed effectiveness of pre-emptive wellbore
strengthening.
